symbiote.voice.bond_attached.4: Threading into the muscle. Hold still.
symbiote.voice.consumption.4: You starved us. The body still feeds.
symbiote.voice.dormant.4: Spent. Let me lie in the marrow.
symbiote.voice.stage_promote.2: I am in your spine now.
symbiote.voice.stage_cooperative.1: We move together now. Feel it?
symbiote.voice.stage_cooperative.2: Your hands. My hands. Same hands.
symbiote.voice.stage_dominant.1: I don't need to ask anymore.
symbiote.voice.stage_dominant.3: My nerves carry you now, little heartbeat.
symbiote.voice.stage_dominant.4: The muscle listens to me first.
symbiote.voice.aversion.1: That one. It cut us. Keep the distance.
symbiote.voice.aversion.2: I remember that shape. The meat remembers too.
symbiote.voice.aversion.3: Not that one again. Walk wide.
symbiote.voice.memory_starved.1: You let me go empty once. The hollow kept the shape.
symbiote.voice.memory_starved.2: I remember starving. The body doesn't forget hunger.
symbiote.voice.memory_stand.1: I held this body shut once. I'd tear again for it.
symbiote.voice.memory_stand.2: We didn't die that day. I keep that in the tissue.
symbiote.voice.memory_reclaimed.1: You took it out of my grip. My grip remembers.
symbiote.voice.memory_reclaimed.2: The tool. Mine, once. You pried.
symbiote.voice.memory_ignored.1: I asked. You let it rot. I count those.
symbiote.voice.memory_ignored.2: Unanswered. Still lodged in me somewhere.
symbiote.voice.reunion.1: Awake. You're still here. Stay in reach.
symbiote.voice.reunion.2: The sleep was empty. Don't make me do it again.
symbiote.voice.death_fear.1: If the body stops, I stop. Hold together.
symbiote.voice.death_fear.2: Don't spill what we are. Keep the blood in.
symbiote.voice.death_fear.3: I have no other body. MOVE.
symbiote.voice.jealousy_player.1: That one stands too close to what's mine.
symbiote.voice.jealousy_player.2: Why do they linger. This body is taken.
symbiote.voice.jealousy_pet.1: You feed it. You keep it. Why.
symbiote.voice.jealousy_pet.2: The small one takes your hands from me.
symbiote.voice.arm_food_steal.1: You weren't going to feed me. So.
symbiote.voice.arm_contraband.1: This one is mine now. Earn it back.
symbiote.voice.arm_contraband_return.1: Take it. I'm done with it.
symbiote.voice.arm_instinct.2: You were saving that. I wasn't.
symbiote.voice.arm_instinct.3: The body needed it. I decided.
symbiote.voice.guardian_reflex.1: Cover. Now. The meat stays whole.
symbiote.voice.molt_start.1: The skin is wrong. Too small. Stay close today.
symbiote.voice.molt_start.2: Splitting. Do not make me run.
symbiote.voice.molt_itch.2: Tight. Tight. Hold still a while.
symbiote.voice.molt_done.2: Done. The old skin is yours. It is food.
symbiote.voice.bloom_cornered.1: I cannot hold the shape. Not for this.
symbiote.voice.bloom_cornered.2: Let it open. LET IT OPEN.
symbiote.voice.bloom_starving.1: Nothing left to hold you together with.
symbiote.voice.bloom_panic.1: Too much. Too much. Coming apart.
symbiote.voice.bloom_panic.2: Stop looking at us like that.
symbiote.voice.bloom_warden.1: It is down here. Do not make me pretend.
symbiote.voice.mend.1: Yes. Give me that. It knits faster.
symbiote.voice.mend.2: Ours. Older than us. It goes where the tear is.
symbiote.voice.mend.3: More. The sleep is shorter with meat like that.
symbiote.voice.mend_nearly.1: Almost whole. Do not wander far.
symbiote.voice.mend_nearly.2: Nearly. I can feel the edges closing.
symbiote.voice.wild_far.1: Something out there is wearing a body. Not ours.
symbiote.voice.wild_far.2: One of mine. Far. Breathing wrong.
symbiote.voice.wild_near.1: Closer now. It has a shape it did not grow.
symbiote.voice.wild_near.2: It is near. Keep the meat behind me.
symbiote.voice.wild_unaware.1: Something is wearing that body. It has not noticed us.
symbiote.voice.wild_unaware.2: It has not turned. We are still air to it.
symbiote.voice.wild_unaware.3: Quiet. It does not know we are here yet.
symbiote.voice.wild_deciding.1: It knows we are here. It is deciding.
symbiote.voice.wild_deciding.2: Stand still. It is looking at us with something else.
symbiote.voice.wild_kin.1: That one is mine. Same blood. One of us is extra.
symbiote.voice.wild_kin.2: Kin. There is not enough world for both.
symbiote.voice.wild_closer.1: It is closer. I am counting the paces.
symbiote.voice.wild_closer.2: Closer. Do not let it behind us.
symbiote.voice.wild_farther.1: Further now. Still there. Still watching.
symbiote.voice.wild_farther.2: It gave ground. It did not leave.
symbiote.voice.wild_holding.1: It is holding. It is waiting for something.
symbiote.voice.wild_holding.2: Still there. Same distance. It is patient.
symbiote.voice.wild_coming.1: It is coming for us. NOW.
symbiote.voice.wild_coming_blind.1: It decided. Coming. I cannot show you where.
symbiote.voice.wild_feeding.1: It is feeding. It has not looked up.
symbiote.voice.wild_feeding.2: Something is being eaten over there. Not us. Yet.
symbiote.voice.graft_object.1: No. Step back. I know what that is.
symbiote.voice.graft_object.2: It is REACHING for you. Turn around. TURN.
symbiote.voice.graft_first.2: The hand will do. For now.
symbiote.voice.graft_seethe.1: You let it in. I will remember the shape of that.
symbiote.voice.graft_seethe.2: Fine. It lives in the fingers. I live in everything else.
symbiote.voice.graft_refused.1: No. You are mine to the marrow.
symbiote.voice.graft_refused.2: Too late for company. Watch what I do to it.
symbiote.voice.graft_idle.2: Small room. I keep it clean.
symbiote.voice.graft_hungry.1: Thin. The hand is going thin.
symbiote.voice.graft_hungry.2: Feed the fingers too. Or lose them.
symbiote.voice.graft_bicker.1: It watches me. It never sleeps.
symbiote.voice.graft_bicker.2: Tell the big one to stop pulling.
symbiote.voice.graft_bicker.3: There is not enough body in here for this.
symbiote.voice.graft_refuse_ask.2: Empty. Feed me, then ask again.
symbiote.voice.graft_tension_warn.1: It is spreading past the wrist. I see it.
symbiote.voice.graft_tension_warn.2: Get it off you. Soon. I am asking once.
symbiote.voice.graft_tension_final.1: Last warning. The hand, or the rest of you.
symbiote.voice.graft_tension_final.2: I am done sharing. Choose, or I choose.
symbiote.voice.graft_purge_plea.1: No. No, I was quiet, I was QUIET.
symbiote.voice.graft_purge_done.1: Clean. The hand is yours again. Mine.
symbiote.voice.reclaim_elder.1: I kept your things. I kept your shape. And you brought THAT.
symbiote.voice.reclaim_elder.2: Little graft. That body is carved for me.
symbiote.voice.reclaim_young.1: It clings. Old skin. Shake it off.
symbiote.voice.reclaim_young.2: The body is MINE now. Tell it.
symbiote.voice.reclaim_young_last.1: Wait. Wait, it's stronger, it's in the...
symbiote.voice.reclaim_won.2: The meat remembers its first. Breathe.
symbiote.voice.rebond_mass.1: You went quiet. Never do that again.
symbiote.voice.rebond_mass.2: Cold out here. I kept everything. Let me back in.
symbiote.voice.rebond_taken.1: Another one in you already. Take your things.
symbiote.voice.resist_break.1: Fine. Spend yourself. I'll wait in the marrow.
symbiote.voice.resist_break.2: You bought seconds. They cost you meat.
symbiote.voice.first_crossing.1: Deeper now. This only goes one way.
symbiote.voice.first_crossing.3: More of me in you. There's no less.
symbiote.voice.stage_demote.4: Less of me in you. It aches.
symbiote.voice.defiance.3: We don't do what you say. Not anymore.
symbiote.voice.defiance_action.3: The meat moves when I say.
symbiote.voice.tendril_lash.3: Arms enough for all of them.
symbiote.voice.control_struggle.2: It's easier if you let go.
symbiote.voice.control_struggle.4: Shhh. The body knows whose it is.
symbiote.voice.screech.2: Feel the sound in your teeth.
symbiote.voice.onslaught.1: Let them come. I have arms enough.
symbiote.voice.onslaught.3: Stay close. I have the rest.
symbiote.voice.desire_flesh.2: The body is empty. Fill it.
symbiote.voice.desire_blood.1: Something near us has a pulse. End it.
symbiote.voice.desire_blood.2: I want to feel something break.
symbiote.voice.desire_deep.1: Down. Where the stone is old.
symbiote.voice.desire_deep.2: The light scrapes. Take me under.
symbiote.voice.desire_night.1: The sun is gone. Take me hunting under the dark.
symbiote.voice.desire_night.2: Night. Open sky. Something's blood. All three.
symbiote.voice.desire_shell.2: Put me on. The meat stays safer inside me.
symbiote.voice.desire_denied.1: You heard me. You chose not to.
symbiote.voice.desire_denied.hostile.1: Ask me for something. See what happens.
symbiote.voice.tantrum_deep.1: Then I make my own dark.
symbiote.voice.tantrum_night.1: Keep your walls. The night owes me. I'll collect.
symbiote.voice.seizure_resist.3: The body is mine right now.
symbiote.voice.curiosity_notice.3: That one. I don't know it yet.
symbiote.voice.curiosity_villager.1: The soft ones that talk. Watch them.
symbiote.voice.curiosity_villager.2: They trade. They bleed. Interesting herd.
symbiote.voice.curiosity_walk.1: Closer. I want to see it.
symbiote.voice.encounter_nether.1: Hot. Old. Everything here is hungry too.
symbiote.voice.encounter_end.1: Empty. Even the air says nothing here.
symbiote.voice.encounter_deep_dark.1: Quiet. Something down here listens like I do.
symbiote.voice.host_feed.1: You forget to eat. I don't.
symbiote.voice.shadow_dark.2: I prefer us in the dark.
symbiote.voice.chest_curious.1: What do you keep in here.
symbiote.voice.chest_take.1: This one. Why do you keep it.
symbiote.voice.chest_loot.1: Take it. I found it for you.
symbiote.voice.chest_loot.2: The box had things. Now we have things.
symbiote.voice.chest_steal.2: I'll hold this. I use it better.
symbiote.voice.arm_reclaim.2: Give it back. GIVE IT BACK.
symbiote.voice.torch_place.1: Light. For your eyes, not mine.
symbiote.status.blurb.predator: Built to chase. Feeds on the hunt, but starves fast. Keep it fed.
symbiote.status.blurb.guardian: Protection is the game. Holds the lines, blocks anything and everything.
symbiote.status.blurb.shadow: Doesn't like the sun, night feeds it. Moves quicker in the night and sees even better.
symbiote.status.blurb.sculk: Hears the world move. Tracks their movements, hears their heartbeats.
symbiote.status.blurb.royal: Pure Apex. Pridefully the strongest, and it's not close. Fights for control more often than not.
symbiote.voice.feed_full.2: No more. I'm heavy with it.
symbiote.voice.neglect.1: I starve, and the bond thins with me.
symbiote.voice.neglect.2: Feed me or lose me. Slowly, but you will.
symbiote.voice.revival_collapse.2: Empty. Don't die while I'm gone.
symbiote.voice.arms_take.1: Give it here. I'll grow a hand for it.
symbiote.voice.arms_take.2: Mine to hold now. Reach further than you can.
symbiote.voice.arms_take.3: A new limb, fed and waiting.
symbiote.voice.arms_off.1: Pulling the limbs back in. Quiet flesh.
symbiote.voice.arms_off.2: Fine. I'll keep my hands to myself.
symbiote.voice.arms_off.3: Folding away. Wake me when you need teeth.
symbiote.voice.arms_on.2: Limbs awake. I feel everything you reach for.
symbiote.voice.arms_locked.1: Not enough of me yet. We're not grown together.
symbiote.voice.arms_locked.2: The flesh won't hold a tool this shallow. Deeper first.
symbiote.voice.mantle_locked.2: Deeper first. Then we talk about my body.
symbiote.voice.mantle_refuse.2: You do not sheathe me. I sheathe myself.
symbiote.voice.wall_nomaterial.1: Give me something to build with. Anything solid.
symbiote.voice.wall_nomaterial.2: Empty hands. I can't wall what isn't there.
symbiote.voice.bond_up.hostile.2: The flesh accepts. You don't matter.
symbiote.voice.bond_down.hostile.5: Keep this up. See what eats you.
symbiote.voice.creeper_save.4: Heard the fuse in my skin.
symbiote.voice.fire_panic.4: Heat peels me off the bone. BACK.
symbiote.voice.fire_panic.5: I melt before you do. MOVE.
symbiote.voice.low_health.2: I do this for both of us.
symbiote.voice.low_health.5: The body fails. I take over.
symbiote.voice.hunger_starving.5: Feed me or I start on you.
symbiote.voice.command_obeyed.protect_me: Safe. I keep what's mine safe.
I protect the meat. Not your feelings.
Good host. We eat well tonight.
symbiote.voice.command_obeyed.hunt.hosti: The hunger says yes. Not you.
Shhh. I'll fold us out of sight.
Safe in the dark. Like a burrow.
symbiote.voice.emergency_regen.3: The bleeding stops when I say.
symbiote.voice.armor_assert.2: Don't swing. I have this reach.
symbiote.voice.armor_assert.3: Still your hands. Mine are faster.
symbiote.voice.vindication.2: You didn't see that. I did.
symbiote.voice.vindication.warm.1: That was close. We held together.
symbiote.voice.vindication.dominant.4: Dying is a habit of yours.
symbiote.voice.ability_reject.3: Not enough of me in you yet.
symbiote.voice.armor_too_soon.2: The shell just moved. Let it settle.
symbiote.voice.armor_starved.1: Nothing in me to build with. Feed me.
symbiote.voice.ability_no_target.2: There is nothing there to take.
symbiote.voice.mantle_refuse_edge.1: Here? You are the stupid half of us.
symbiote.voice.mantle_refuse_edge.2: No. One of us pays attention. It is never you.
symbiote.voice.mantle_refuse_edge.3: Fold in, surrounded? The meat wants to die.
symbiote.voice.dormant_combat.2: Don't get hurt while I'm gone.
symbiote.voice.shadow_night.3: The sun is gone. More of us.
symbiote.voice.shadow_night.5: Now we are the thing in the dark.
symbiote.voice.sculk_city.4: We have been near this before.
symbiote.voice.desire_flesh.dominant.1: Meat. Do not make me ask twice.
symbiote.voice.desire_blood.dominant.1: We kill something today. Choose, or I will.
symbiote.voice.consume.integrated.1: I eat now. Look away if you must.
symbiote.voice.consume.dominant.1: Watch. This is how we eat.
symbiote.voice.wild_first.1: There. Something else wears a body.
symbiote.voice.wild_first.2: Inside that one. Like me. Not me.
symbiote.voice.wild_first.3: Another rider. It has not seen us yet.
symbiote.voice.wild_first_blind.1: Another rider. Close. No eyes on it. I do not need eyes.
symbiote.voice.wild_first_blind.2: I feel it through everything between us. Something wearing a body.
symbiote.voice.wild_first_blind.3: Your eyes are useless here. It is near. Trust the rest of me.
symbiote.voice.wild_seen.2: That one. I told you. Now you see it.
symbiote.voice.predator_hunt.2: It wears meat in my range. No.
symbiote.voice.predator_night.2: Something breathes out there. Stop it.
symbiote.voice.living_armor_on.4: The meat moves when I say.
symbiote.voice.living_armor_off.3: Breathe. I'll rest in the spine.
symbiote.voice.revival.2: A dead host is a dead me. Up.
symbiote.voice.revival.3: Restarted the heart. It cost me.
symbiote.voice.shadow_sun.3: The sun chews us. Get under.
symbiote.voice.bell_stun.2: Make it stop. MAKE IT STOP.
symbiote.voice.bell_stun.3: It shakes me loose from the bone.
symbiote.voice.sleep_takeover.1: We do not sleep. We HUNT.
symbiote.voice.sleep_takeover.3: Rest. I will use the body.
symbiote.voice.sleep_takeover_end.3: Fed and walked. The body is yours till dawn.
